breaking_news.headline: EPA proposes weakening heavy-duty truck pollution rules
breaking_news.summary: The Trump EPA calls Biden-era rules for cutting pollution from heavy trucks "unworkable." The proposed changes have been celebrated by trucking groups and denounced by environmental groups.

breaking_news.headline: Gas prices are swinging. How to budget for volatility
breaking_news.summary: Gas prices have fluctuated since the U.S. and Israel launched a war on Iran, which disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and left consumers unsure of what they'll pay at the pump.

breaking_news.headline: Microsoft is doing a hard reset of its Xbox gaming division
breaking_news.summary: This week, Microsoft announced they were laying off over 3,000 staff at Xbox. What will the impact be on the company? And what do these layoffs say about the gaming industry right now?

breaking_news.headline: Largest housing affordability bill in decades becomes law without Trump's signature
breaking_news.summary: President Trump refused to sign the bill without Congress first passing his sweeping voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Department subpoenas New York Times reporters over Air Force One reporting
breaking_news.summary: The Times says federal agents turned up on the doorsteps of several of its journalists to force grand jury testimony next week over their coverage of the Air Force One plane gifted to Trump by Qatar.

breaking_news.headline: What a Monopoly importer learned when it tried to make things in the U.S.A.
breaking_news.summary: After getting hit with tariffs for the imported board games he sells, Jonathan Silva decided to see if he could produce a version of his Monopoly game in the United States. This is what he learned.

breaking_news.headline: EV battery recycling has a math problem
breaking_news.summary: For some electric vehicle batteries, it costs more to recycle them than they're worth. That creates all kinds of problems, which a new Colorado law aims to solve.

breaking_news.headline: States sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros blockbuster merger
breaking_news.summary: California is among the states suing to block Paramount from buying Warner Bros. Discovery in a Hollywood mega-merger that would unite some of the nation's largest movie studios and TV newsrooms.

breaking_news.headline: UK-Switzerland deal to scrap roaming charges and allow Britons to use e-gates
breaking_news.summary: The UK signs a new services deal with Switzerland it says will increase exports by £5.2bn annually "in the long run".

breaking_news.headline: Lindsey Graham's sister chosen as replacement after senator's death
breaking_news.summary: The South Carolina governor chose the senator's little sister to serve out the rest of his term after Graham's death on Saturday.

breaking_news.headline: Wildfire raging south of Paris could have been set deliberately, says minister
breaking_news.summary: The interior minister has said the fire near Paris could have been set deliberately and two people have been arrested.

breaking_news.headline: 'Hero, legend, sweetheart': Tributes to Jurassic Park actor Sam Neill, who has died aged 78
breaking_news.summary: Friends, politicians and fellow film stars remember Neill following his "sudden and unexpected" death.

breaking_news.headline: At least 28 killed, 25 critically injured after fire engulfs Bangkok bar
breaking_news.summary: Firefighters arrived at the scene in the Chatuchak district to find patrons running through flames to escape.

breaking_news.headline: Hungary parliament votes to remove president from office
breaking_news.summary: Tamás Sulyok was widely seen as a loyalist of former prime minister Viktor Orbán, who lost power in April after 16 years.

breaking_news.headline: Briton tells of surviving Spain wildfire in car as wife and friends died trying to run to safety
breaking_news.summary: Malcolm Timbrell's wife and their friends are thought to have died when a devastating wildfire tore through their village in Spain.

breaking_news.headline: The SpaceX IPO made history. One month on has it lost momentum?
breaking_news.summary: A month on from the firm's stock market debut, the reality of how SpaceX currently makes money has seemed to come into clearer focus.

breaking_news.headline: How to change bank, energy or broadband provider and save money
breaking_news.summary: Changing your broadband or energy supplier, or even your bank, for a better deal is simpler than it used to be.

breaking_news.headline: Is tracking your food purchases good for your health?
breaking_news.summary: Food tracking apps are popular, but are they a good way to make us eat a healthier diet?

breaking_news.headline: UAE condemns Iran's 'brazen' attack on tankers as US launches fresh strikes
breaking_news.summary: The third consecutive night of US strikes on Iran came as Trump announced a 20% charge as part of a new blockade on the strait.

breaking_news.headline: Volkswagen planning to cut up to 100,000 jobs globally
breaking_news.summary: The group, which includes Porsche and Audi, has faced a steep fall in profits and tough competition from China.
